children: Himadri Buch Mumbai: The initial public offering of Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India, plans to launch its IPO next week, people familiar with the development told ET. The IPO of the company is likely to open on November 19 and close on November 23. The issue size of the proposed IPO is expected to be around 10,000 crore, said the people cited above. "The IPO will launch on November 19 while the price band is likely to be announced on Monday (November 16)," said a person familiar with the matter.

The company received approval for its share sale from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on November 4. Emails and messages sent to the bankers remained unanswered until the publication of this report. Coal India plans to divest up to 10% of its stake in MCL through the IPO. The proposed issue will comprise an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 66.18 crore equity shares by the parent company, Coal India, according to MCL's draft red herring prospectus (DRHP).

title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO May Open Next Week
